caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate, full-length dress with a fitted bodice and a wide, voluminous skirt. The garment is rendered in shades of cream or pale beige, featuring a square neckline and long sleeves that flare at the elbow, where they are trimmed with white lace. Decorative ruffles edged with small pink and green floral motifs run vertically down the bodice and both sides of the dress's front opening, as well as around the sleeves and at the base of the skirt. The main fabric of the dress is adorned with small clusters of pink and green flowers distributed evenly across the surface. The ruffles and trims appear to have multi-colored detailing in pastel shades, harmonizing with the floral embroidery. The overall composition shows the dress isolated on a neutral off-white background, without any visible mannequin or figure, focusing solely on the details and embellishments of the garment.
title: Dress
